altitude.note: Altitude of the detector position above the WGS-84 ellipsoid, not the mountain surface.
altitude.quote: altitude 370 m above the conventional (WGS-84) geodetic ellipsoid

coordinates.note: Decimal conversion of 36 deg 25' 32.6" N, 137 deg 18' 37.1" E (WGS-84) as determined by the GPS survey reported in the detector paper.
coordinates.quote: at geographic coordinates 36 25' 32.6" N, 137 18' 37.1" E, and altitude 370 m above the conventional (WGS-84) geodetic ellipsoid, as determined by a GPS survey

depth.quote: The detector cavity lies under the peak of Mt. Ikenoyama, with 1000 m of rock, or 2700 meters-water-equivalent (m.w.e.) mean overburden

depth_mwe.quote: with 1000 m of rock, or 2700 meters-water-equivalent (m.w.e.) mean overburden

summary.plain: A cavern a kilometre inside a mountain in the Mozumi mine near Hida, Gifu. It holds the Super-Kamiokande water tank, reached by a horizontal tunnel from the valley.
summary.technical: Underground site under the peak of Mt. Ikenoyama with 1000 m of rock (2700 m.w.e.) mean overburden; geodetic position from the GPS survey reported in the Super-Kamiokande detector paper.
